lines: Office of the Secretary of State
The Alabarna Republican Party hereby certifies that the attached documents found in the
shared Dropbox folder are a correct return of the votes cast in the August 11 , 2026 Special
Republican Primary Election. The vote totals are confirmed to reflect the official canvass
repMs collected from each county by ALGOP and are accurate to the best of our knowledge.
The Alabama Republican Party hereby cettifies that the names below have won their primary
and shall appear on the 2026 Alabama general election ballot to be held on November 3, 2026.
This certificate is subject to such disqualifications or corrective action as hereafter may be
Given under my hand, the twentieth day of August, 2026.
